snippet.title: Bocage, a cozy puzzle game
snippet.description:
Bocage, a cozy puzzle game 🐄🌾
Free demo available now on Steam. Full release March 1, 2027.

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4938320/Bocage_a_cozy_puzzle_game/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=trailer

Place tetromino-shaped farm pieces on a grid. Each piece has its own rule: cows need an enclosure, windmills turn the meadows around them into wheat, bridges carry rules across the water... Every world brings a new rule, from the countryside to the Far West and even outer space.

No timer, no score, no fail state. Just you, the pieces, and the satisfying click when everything fits.

✿ 400+ handcrafted puzzles, all validated by a custom solver
✿ Themed worlds, each with a new rule
✿ A hint system for when you're stuck
✿ Level editor: create your own puzzles and share them with a code
✿ Available in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Simplified Chinese and Japanese

Made by one French solo dev, on evenings and weekends.

💬 Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/uXBTQypp6

#cozygames #puzzlegame #indiegame
